g.text: A provider is the AI service that answers your messages —
for example OpenAI, Anthropic, or a server running on this
1. ● Connect a provider (API key or local server)
3. ○ Send your first message Composer unlocks after setup
Ctrl+Shift+F focus | F6 next pane | Shift+F6 previous pane | F1 help | Enter continue setup | Y trace | Ctrl+K switch session | Ctrl+T new tab | Ctrl+P · Ctrl+Q
